title.description: Title shown in the frame chrome.

state.description: The state to render. The session controller decides which state applies; the renderer shows an engine failure of its own as 'engine-load-failed'. Default `'empty'`.

error.description: Recovery message shown with the frame's reload control while it is non-empty.

ownerGeometry.description: The grid the session's owner dictates. A `'read-only'` terminal adopts it, scrolling locally when it is larger than the viewport, instead of fitting itself to the viewport.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name of the terminal input surface. Default `Terminal`.

announceOutput.description: Mirror engine output into a bounded screen-reader live region. Default `false`.

maximumPasteBytes.description: The most paste text, in UTF-8 bytes, offered for review. A larger paste is refused whole and nothing is sent. Anything outside the range uses the default. Default `65536`.

class.description: Additional class merged with the component's root class.

unsupportedProps.name: controller
unsupportedProps.description: The session controller whose output the terminal renders. It is borrowed: the terminal unsubscribes when the controller is replaced or the component unmounts and never disposes it.

unsupportedProps.name: onGeometryChange
unsupportedProps.description: Called with the engine's measured geometry, once per accepted change. The engine's cell measurement is the sole resize authority; the frame's own estimate is never forwarded. A terminal that does not own the grid never calls it.

unsupportedProps.name: onInputRefused
unsupportedProps.description: Called when input, or part of it, did not reach the wire. Input is never queued, retried, or replayed, so this is the only record of what was dropped and why.

unsupportedProps.name: onLinkActivate
unsupportedProps.description: Called with a visible HTTPS address the reader deliberately activated. Links are disabled unless this is set; hidden OSC 8 destinations, paths, and other schemes are never offered.

unsupportedProps.name: onRecoveryRequest
unsupportedProps.description: Called when the reader activates the frame's recovery control.

unsupportedProps.name: onTitleChange
unsupportedProps.description: Called with the terminal title the program set, as bounded plain text.
